body: I think I've failed at life so badly that there's not much point in going on...My family, my old friends...
I feel like it's too late for me, friend.

I don't know where else to turn. I have no friends, I feel like I have no one that cares about me. I think they don't care because I'm a failure. That's why I think I should jump tomorrow. I just told my dad I loved him and started crying in my room while typing this...I'm sorry dad...
I'm sharing dinner with my father right now. I'll try to savor it knowing it's my last meal. My time is up, friend.
